properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) modular multiplications; Space: O(N)
properties.ring_modulus: q = 3329, primitive 256th root of unity w = 17

properties.name: AVX-512 Byte and Word Instructions (AVX-512BW)
properties.throughput_bounds: 32 parallel 16-bit word operations per SIMD vector cycle

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Multiply packed signed 16-bit integers in zmm2 and zmm3/m512, store low 16 bits in zmm1

properties.operation: Accelerates polynomial multiplication in Quotient Ring R_q

properties.vector_width: 32x 16-bit ring coefficients processed simultaneously per SIMD lane

properties.stage: Montgomery coefficient multiplication in butterfly network

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 512-bit vector register containing 32 NTT polynomial coefficients
